# Enzo Tartaglione, enzotarta.github.io

> Personal academic website of Enzo Tartaglione, Full Professor at Télécom
> Paris (Institut Polytechnique de Paris). Research on deep neural network
> compression, pruning, model debiasing, privacy in AI, 3D Gaussian Splatting,
> and regularization for deep learning.

## Identity

- Name: Enzo Tartaglione
- Affiliation: Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris
- Role: Full Professor in Deep Learning and Efficient AI (since Jan 2026); Head of the Multimedia team
- Email: enzo.tartaglione@telecom-paris.fr
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=uKuvN64AAAAJ
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4274-8298
- GitHub: https://github.com/enzotarta
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/enzo-tartaglione-490950a2

## Distinctions and leadership

- Oral papers at ICLR 2026, ICIP 2026, AAAI 2025, WACV 2025 and ICME 2025; spotlight paper at ICLR 2023
- Principal Investigator: FIS2 Starting Grant (Italian Ministry of University and Research), ANR JCJC, two Hi!Paris chairs; task leader in the Horizon Europe project ELIAS
- Finalist, Multimedia Rising Star Award, IEEE MMSP 2025
- Eduardo Caianiello Award, ICIAP 2023
- Keynote speaker, Picture Coding Symposium (PCS) 2025
- Area Chair: NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICLR, ICASSP; Associate Editor of IEEE TNNLS and EURASIP JIVP; Action Editor of TMLR
- Elected member of the IEEE Signal Processing Society Multimedia Signal Processing Technical Committee (MMSP TC), 2026
- Peer review recognitions: Top Area Chair, NeurIPS 2026; Outstanding Reviewer, CVPR 2025, ICLR 2025, CVPR 2021
- Supervision: 6 Ph.D. graduates, 10 Ph.D. students in progress

## Structured data

The publications page exposes JSON-LD `ScholarlyArticle` entries for every
peer-reviewed paper and preprint. Topic tags for each paper live in
[/_data/research_tree.json](https://enzotarta.github.io/_data/research_tree.json).
